title: Flash 8 re-theme Wave A: spec doc + design-token module + Shell chrome conversion (dark→light Halo)
description:
FOUNDATION for matching the Macromedia Flash Pro 8 UI exactly. The current authoring-ui is inline-styled, ~500 hardcoded hex across 43 panels + 10 dialogs, and WRONG base scheme: it's DARK; Flash 8 is LIGHT gray (Halo). This task creates the single source of truth + converts the app chrome as the reference pattern; per-panel conversions follow in later waves.

DELIVER:
1) docs/30-flash8-ui-spec.md — the definitive spec (commit the values below, organized: System A IDE chrome, System B Halo widgets, Flash-drawn content, metrics, known-gaps).
2) packages/authoring-ui/src/theme/flash8Theme.ts — exported design tokens (named, grouped chrome/widget/content) + small style helpers (panel, titleBar, button(state), input, bevel). Use EXACT values:
 CHROME (light; best-estimate, screenshot-refine later): appBg/panelBg/menuBg #ECECEC; insetFieldStrip #D4D4D4; separator #999999; textDefault #000000; textDisabled #808080; bevelEdge 2px; borderThin 1px; font 'Tahoma, "MS Shell Dlg", sans-serif' 11px / lineHeight 13px; -webkit-font-smoothing: never subpixel (use antialiased/none).
 HALO WIDGETS (confirmed from flex-sdk halo/defaults.css): themeColor/haloBlue #009DFF; selectionColor(row) #7FCEFF; rollOverColor(hover) #B2E1FF; inactiveSelection #E8E8E8; selectionDisabled #DDDDDD; text #0B333C; disabledText #AAB3B3; textRollOver/Selected #2B333C; iconColor #2B333C; disabledIcon #999999; buttonColor #6F7777; error #FF0000; borderColor #B7BABC; borderCap #919999; shadow #EEEEEE; appBgBlue #869CA7 (grad #9CB0BA→#68808C); panelContentBg #FFFFFF; panelHeaderGrad #E7E7E7→#D9D9D9; footerGrad #E7E7E7→#C7C7C7; headerDivider #AEAEAE; separatorHalo #C4CCCC; divider #6F7777; gridLineH #F7F7F7; gridLineV #D5DDDD; alternatingRows #F7F7F7/#FFFFFF; button fills up #FFFFFF→#CCCCCC (a .6/.4), over #FFFFFF→#EEEEEE (a .75/.65), down #D8F0FF→#99D7FF; button border up #B7BABC→#5B5D5E, over/down #009DFF→#0075BF; cornerRadius 4; textInput bg #FFFFFF border inset #B7BABC (dark #6D6F70/light #D3D5D6); focusRing #009DFF 2px a0.5; checkbox/radio 14x14; widget font 'Verdana' 10px.
 CONTENT (Flash-drawn, confirmed): motionTween #CCCCFF; shapeTween #CCFFCC; brokenTween dashed; selectedFrame #335EA8; playhead #CC0000; timelineGridline #EBE9ED (frame pitch 8px, layer row ~18px, ruler header ~23px); emptyFrame #FFFFFF; keyframeFilled #000000 / keyframeHollow white; pasteboard #D0D0D0; stage #FFFFFF + ~1px #CDCDCD edge shadow; guide ~cyan; default doc 550x400 12fps 100%.
 METRICS: panel title bar ~16px; gripper 1px dots @2px pitch, 2 rows; bevel 2px; border 1px; tools panel ~67px; tool cell ~22px.
3) Convert packages/authoring-ui/src/Shell.tsx (app shell + all its style objects: shell/topPanel/leftPanel/bottomPanel/centerRegion/mainColumn/dropOverlay) to import tokens and adopt the LIGHT chrome (panelBg #ECECEC, near-black text, Tahoma) — flipping the dark base. This is the REFERENCE conversion other panels will mirror.

KNOWN GAP (document in the spec): exact XP-Luna IDE panel gray is best-estimate #ECECEC; flag for a one-time screenshot-sampling refinement.

VERIFY: pnpm --filter './packages/**' build green; authoring-ui typecheck + tests pass (only ~3 task-1207 fixture failures acceptable). If you can run the app/screenshot to sanity-check the shell now reads light-gray, do so; otherwise note it for the panel waves. Mark done via ./task; commit (incl. task file, nothing under .claude/); push rebase-retry to origin/main.
